sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; SI bands referenced include below ₹1.5L, ₹1.5L–2L, 2L–5L, 5L–10L, above 10L for various benefits

room_rent.note: For SI <5L: 1.75% of SI/day in Class A cities, 1.50% elsewhere. For SI ≥5L (excl. critical illness SI): no room rent cap. Room rent cap can also be removed for SI <5L on payment of 6% additional premium (optional extension).

icu.note: For SI <5L: 3% of SI/day in Class A cities, 2.5% elsewhere. For SI ≥5L: no ICU cap. Proportionate deduction does not apply for ICU charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay by default. Optional co-pay of 10%, 20% or 25% can be chosen; once opted cannot be removed during policy period.

sub_limits.display: Domiciliary capped at 20% of SI; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation sub-limit: 20% of SI. Modern treatments: up to 50% of SI. Ambulance: 1% of SI or ₹2,500 whichever less. Service/surcharge: 0.5% of SI per hospitalisation. No disease-wise sub-limits on main hospitalisation cover.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Cataract, BPH, hysterectomy for menorrhagia/fibromyoma, hernia, hydrocele, fistula-in-ano, piles, sinusitis, cholelithiasis/cholecystectomy. Also 90-day wait for diseases aggravated by diabetes/hypertension (if not PED).

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of basic SI after first claim-free year, then 10% per subsequent claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at rate accrued on claim. Alternatively, insured may opt for 5% No Claim Discount on premium instead of CB at renewal.

restoration.display: Once per policy year, 100% of basic SI
restoration.note: Reinstated SI available for same illness (except chronic diseases listed) or different illness/injury. Not available for domiciliary hospitalisation, critical illness extension, or cumulative bonus. Reinstatement premium charged from second claim onwards. Not available for SI <₹1.5L.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (383 listed in Annexure C)

domiciliary.note: Several diseases excluded from domiciliary cover including asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, critical illness etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment including pre- and post-hospitalisation covered up to sum insured per policy period.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered subject to insured's sub-limits. Donor room rent limited to 50% of insured's room rent entitlement. Ambulance, pre/post-hosp and daily allowance not payable for donor.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy etc.) up to 50% of SI per policy period.

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, and many consumables listed in Annexure A List I as non-payable items.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit restricts all treatment to India only. Emergency assistance services available within India (150+ km from home) only.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, adventure sports (non-professional too), acupuncture/acupressure, intra-articular injections, OPD-only procedures converted to day care, pre/post-natal, external congenital anomalies, cytotron/RFQMR/EECP/chelation therapy
optional_riders: Higher SI for Critical Illness (equal to basic SI); No-limit room rent/ICU (6% add-on premium); Co-payment options (10%/20%/25%)
insurer: IFFCO TOKIO General Insurance Company Limited
